reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Application of chapter to stored grain and warehouse operations
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter provisions to all grain stored or handled and warehouse operations regardless of grain ownership.

headings.title: Uniform Commercial Code application to warehouse receipts
headings.reviewNote: Subjects warehouse receipts to UCC document of title provisions except where inconsistent with express chapter terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, 1986 effective date, and 1981 8th Cir. bankruptcy annotation (State of Missouri v. U.S. Bankruptcy Court, 647 F.2d 768) regarding automatic stay applicability; confirmed headings.

headings.title: Exclusive department authority for official grain inspection and grading
headings.reviewNote: Grants department exclusive right to inspect and grade grain under federal standards, preserving owner right to opt out.

headings.title: Exclusive department authority for terminal weighing and fee agreements
headings.reviewNote: Grants exclusive right to weigh terminal grain absent owner opt-out, authorizing contract weighing on cost-guarantee basis.

headings.title: Preservation of grain exchange weighing rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves right of grain exchanges and boards of trade to weigh or supervise weighing in private and public warehouses.

headings.title: Establishment of chemical laboratories and inspection stations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to establish chemical laboratories, weighing stations, and inspection points at rail terminals and markets.

headings.title: Inspection and weighing of federal grain in temporary warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to service federal grain in temporary unlicensed warehouses upon request and operating cost guarantee.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1941–1980 history note; confirmed official inspection, terminal weighing, grain exchange rights, laboratories, and temporary federal-grain warehouse headings.

headings.title: Supervisory and administrative duties of director
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates director duties to supervise handling, inspection, weighing, laboratory analysis, records, staffing, audits, and fraud prevention.

headings.title: Regulatory, examination, hearing, and subpoena powers of director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rulemaking, forms, warehouse examinations, subpoenas, and administrative hearings to determine surety liability and claim validity.

headings.title: Compliance with administrative rulemaking procedures
headings.reviewNote: Requires all rules promulgated under chapter authority to comply with section 536.024 rulemaking provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed mandatory director duties in subsection 1, permissive powers in subsection 2, and section 536.024 rulemaking requirement in subsection 3.

headings.title: Appointment and qualifications of inspection point managers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointment of qualified, disinterested grain experts with administrative skills to manage official inspection offices.

headings.title: Title, duties, and supervisory role of appointees
headings.reviewNote: Designates appointees as chief inspector, inspector-in-charge, or office manager serving under direct supervision of director.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed inspection-point appointee qualifications, conflict-of-interest bars, titles, and at-will service under the director.

headings.title: Creation and administration of grain inspection fee fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates grain inspection fee fund in state treasury for inspection fee deposits and expenses, exempting fund from general revenue transfers.

headings.title: General revenue transfers to support operations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes annual general revenue transfers up to $500,000 upon Federal Grain Inspection Service approval to support operations.

headings.title: Investment of fund balances by state treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Directs state treasurer to invest unneeded fund balances, crediting all investment earnings to grain inspection fee fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed Grain Inspection Fee Fund creation, non-lapse exemption from section 33.080, $500,000 general revenue transfer authority, and treasurer investment.

headings.title: Official inspection and weighing by qualified appointees
headings.reviewNote: Requires requested official grain inspection and weighing at licensed warehouses or specified conveyances to be performed by director-appointed qualified personnel.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for unauthorized inspection or weighing
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unauthorized grain inspection or weighing as a misdemeanor punishable by fine, jail, or both.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and prior revision notes; tightened subsection 1 title for conciseness and confirmed misdemeanor fine and jail penalties in subsection 2.

headings.title: Examination, audit, and property inspection authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director or agents to inspect warehouses, property, books, accounts, and records during business hours.

headings.title: Inspections based upon available reports and information
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to perform inspections deemed necessary for orderly administration based upon available reports.

headings.title: Mandatory warehouseman cooperation and assistance
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehousemen and personnel to cooperate in examinations, treating noncooperation as grounds for license suspension.

headings.title: Confidentiality of warehouseman information and misdemeanor penalty
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits employees from disclosing warehouseman affairs without written permission, making unauthorized disclosure a misdemeanor.

headings.title: Subpoena duces tecum to financial institutions and business entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to subpoena financial institution and business entity records of licensees or persons requiring licensing.

headings.title: Investigation of verified written complaints
headings.reviewNote: Mandates investigation of verified written complaints alleging chapter violations having a reasonable basis.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections, prior revisions, and 1997 effective date; confirmed examination, cooperation, confidentiality/misdemeanor, financial-record subpoena, and verified-complaint investigation headings.

headings.title: Mandatory annual license for grain storage or grain banks
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits storing grain, soliciting storage, or operating grain banks without keeping in force an annual public warehouse license.

headings.title: Single license for multiple warehouses within operating unit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensing multiple warehouses within 50 miles under single license if operated under common name, staff, and records.

headings.title: Prohibition against storing grain in unlicensed facilities
headings.reviewNote: Bars licensed public warehousemen from storing grain in any unlicensed facility.

headings.title: Administrative penalty for operating without license or bond
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to assess penalties up to $500 per day for operating without license or bond after written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed licensing requirements (with pre-April 22, 1986 license grandfathering), 50-mile single-unit licensing, unlicensed storage bar, and $500/day penalty.

headings.title: Sworn license application on director forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehouse owners and operators to submit sworn, complete license applications on forms prescribed by director.

headings.title: Required financial statement and GAAP standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires six-month balance sheet and income statement prepared under GAAP, authorizing rules for asset appraisals.

headings.title: Mandatory CPA audit or review and preparer independence
headings.reviewNote: Requires financial statements to be audited or reviewed by an independent CPA unaffiliated with applicant.

headings.title: Director authority to require additional financial disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to require additional financial verification, retained earnings statements, and AICPA standard reviews.

headings.title: Filing copies of statements used for bonds or federal agreements
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehousemen to submit copies of financial statements used to secure bonds, CCC agreements, or federal licenses.

headings.title: Applicant certification of financial statement accuracy
headings.reviewNote: Mandates executive certification that financial statements accurately reflect financial condition under statutory penalty.

headings.title: Felony penalty and civil liability for false financial statements
headings.reviewNote: Classifies preparing false statements or failing to disclose known falsity as a class D felony, imposing civil liability to depositors.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections, prior revisions, and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed sworn application, GAAP/CPA financial statement, certification, and class D felony false-statement headings.

headings.title: Annual complete examination and minimum fee
headings.reviewNote: Mandates at least one complete annual warehouse examination at warehouseman's expense with minimum $50 fee, including grain weigh-up or measure-up.

headings.title: Department-funded additional examinations and discrepancy fees
headings.reviewNote: Provides additional department-initiated examinations are at state expense unless discrepancies exist, authorizing fee collection for reexaminations.

headings.title: Warehouseman-requested examinations and fee computation
headings.reviewNote: Permits warehouseman-requested examinations and extra examination work at warehouseman expense covering personal expenses, mileage, and $20 per man-hour.

headings.title: Written discrepancy reports and license disciplinary action
headings.reviewNote: Requires written discrepancy reports with reasonable corrective timeframes, authorizing license suspension or revocation for uncorrected discrepancies.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1997 effective date; hyphenated subsection 3 title and confirmed annual examination, discrepancy fee, $20/man-hour special examination, and discrepancy report headings.

headings.title: Filing of corporate surety bond for storage grain
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate surety bond in favor of state covering unpriced storage grain deposited with warehouseman.

headings.title: Inadmissibility of warehouseman defenses in bond actions
headings.reviewNote: Bars defenses based on self-receipts, grain commingling, or statutory violations in actions upon warehouse bonds.

headings.title: Effective date and continuous force of surety bond
headings.reviewNote: Provides bond takes effect on date of issue, is unaffected by license expiration, and continues until properly cancelled.

headings.title: Duty to maintain continuous bond coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining continuous bond coverage during operations, prohibiting cancellation without approved substitute bond.

headings.title: Requirement of single corporate surety per warehouse
headings.reviewNote: Mandates using the same corporate surety for all bonds required for the operation of any single warehouse.

headings.title: Single bond for multiple warehouse locations
headings.reviewNote: Permits single aggregate bond covering multiple warehouses, subjecting all warehouse assets to liabilities of each warehouse.

headings.title: Director demand, escrow deposit, hearing, and surety penalties
headings.reviewNote: Governs director demand, interpleader or hearings, and 25% penalty plus interest for surety failure to pay or escrow within ten days.

headings.title: Ninety days written notice required for bond cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits bond cancellation without ninety days' prior certified mail notice to director and principal.

headings.title: License suspension, revocation, and depositor removal duty upon cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Directs automatic license suspension at 30 days and revocation at 60 days of cancellation notice, imposing legal duty on depositors to remove grain.

headings.title: Mandatory judicial injunction for grain removal or sale
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to obtain mandatory court injunction ordering grain removal or sale within ten days of petition.

headings.title: Final inspection after ninety-day cancellation period
headings.reviewNote: Requires final warehouse inspection after 90-day cancellation period with examination fee paid by warehouseman.

headings.title: Legal effectiveness and conditions of surety bond binders
headings.reviewNote: Recognizes verbal or written surety binders as legally effective upon agreed premium and essential bond disclosures.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all twelve subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed surety bond requirements, barred defenses, demand/escrow/25% penalty, 90-day cancellation, suspension/revocation, injunction, final inspection, and binder headings.

headings.title: Application of bond rules and certificates of deposit
headings.reviewNote: Extends chapter surety-bond laws and rules to certificates of deposit and irrevocable letters of credit and places submitted CDs in the director's custody as trustee.

headings.title: Irrevocable letters of credit and issuing bank standards
headings.reviewNote: Permits bank irrevocable letters of credit in lieu of bond, authorizing director to reject letters from unstable banks.

headings.title: Demand for payment, escrow, hearing, and bank noncompliance penalty
headings.reviewNote: Governs bank payment on demand, escrow, hearings, and weekly 10% penalty for bank refusal to pay within three days.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1986/1987 history note; edited subsection 1 title to reflect extension of surety-bond rules to CDs and letters of credit alongside CD trustee custody.

headings.title: Table of bond rates based on warehouse capacity
headings.reviewNote: Establishes graduated rate table for bond amounts based on bushel capacity, setting minimum bond at $20,000.

headings.title: One million dollar bond ceiling and net worth deficiency exception
headings.reviewNote: Caps required bond at $1,000,000 while authorizing additional bonding for net worth deficiencies under section 411.280.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, embedded 5-tier bushel-capacity bond table ($20,000 minimum), and 1997 effective date; confirmed rate-table and $1,000,000 ceiling with section 411.280 deficiency exception headings.

headings.title: Director authority to require additional bond after hearing
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director after hearing to require additional bond to protect depositors upon finding warehouseman unable to meet obligations.

headings.title: Limitation on additional bond amount
headings.reviewNote: Restricts additional bond amount to sum necessary to fulfill unmet storage and dollar obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1977 enactment note; confirmed post-hearing additional bond authority and statutory cap tied to unmet storage and dollar obligations.

headings.title: License suitability criteria, facility standards, and denial hearings
headings.reviewNote: Sets licensing criteria including weathertight facility, 10,000-bushel capacity, scale within 5 miles, clean 7-year record, and denial appeal.

headings.title: License expiration date and non-proration of fees
headings.reviewNote: Provides licenses expire on last day of fifth month after fiscal year end and prohibits proration of fees.

headings.title: Posting of license and ten-dollar fee for duplicate
headings.reviewNote: Requires conspicuous license posting in office, authorizing duplicate licenses marked DUPLICATE for $10 fee.

headings.title: Director disciplinary authority to modify, suspend, or revoke license
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to modify, suspend, cancel, revoke, or refuse to renew licenses for statutory or rule violations.

headings.title: Disciplinary orders, certified mail notice, and appeal bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires written orders stating reasons, establishing 30-day appeal timeline and mandatory appeal bond covering storage obligations.

headings.title: Emergency summary suspension by removal of license from premises
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate license removal and suspension when immediate danger of loss exists, requiring hearing within ten days.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed facility/suitability criteria, fiscal-year expiration, posting/$10 duplicate fee, disciplinary orders, jurisdictional appeal bond, and summary license removal.

headings.title: Termination of storage arrangements and delivery under supervision
headings.reviewNote: Directs warehouseman upon revocation to terminate storage arrangements while permitting supervised purchase or delivery of stored grain.

headings.title: Warehouseman termination notice to depositors
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehouseman to send approved notice to depositors announcing termination and delivery schedule.

headings.title: Director notice to depositors and mandatory duty to remove grain
headings.reviewNote: Requires director notice to depositors, imposing legal duty on receipt holders to sell or remove grain forthwith.

headings.title: Mandatory injunction for removal or sale of stored grain
headings.reviewNote: Empowers circuit court on director petition to enter mandatory injunctions ordering grain removal or sale within ten days.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed post-revocation storage termination, warehouseman and director notices, depositor removal duty, and 10-day mandatory injunction hearing.

headings.title: Premises entry, monitoring, cease-shipping orders, and felony penalty
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes premises entry and cease-shipping orders for grain shortages, making shipping violation a class D felony.

headings.title: Assessment of one hundred dollar daily monitoring fee
headings.reviewNote: Assesses warehouseman $100 per person per day for department monitoring upon court finding reasonable grounds existed.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed premises monitoring, cease-shipping orders with class D felony penalty, and $100/person daily monitoring fee.

headings.title: Mandatory insurance coverage for full market value
headings.reviewNote: Requires keeping stored grain insured for full market value against fire, explosion, lightning, and windstorm, exempting self-insured CCC grain.

headings.title: Insurance loss settlement and depositor recovery rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires market value settlement upon demand following loss, granting depositor right to recover directly from insurer after 60 days.

headings.title: Preservation of depositor insurance rights against warehouseman fraud
headings.reviewNote: Protects depositor and receipt holder insurance recovery rights against warehouseman fraud or criminal conduct.

headings.title: Ninety days notice for policy cancellation and license suspension
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits policy cancellation without 90 days' certified notice, providing automatic license suspension at 30 days and revocation at 60 days.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1941–1987 history note; confirmed full-market-value grain insurance, 60-day direct insurer recovery, fraud protection for holders, and 90-day cancellation with 30/60-day license actions.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for unlicensed storage operations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies operating a grain warehouse or grain bank without a license or displaying license as a misdemeanor.

headings.title: One-year refusal period for revoked licensees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to refuse license renewal or issuance for one year following revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed misdemeanor penalty for unlicensed or post-revocation operations and permissive one-year refusal period for revoked licensees.

headings.title: Duty of terminal warehouse to receive grain and inspection rules
headings.reviewNote: Mandates receiving dry, suitable grain to public capacity, requiring official inspection and weighing absent owner or warehouse opt-out.

headings.title: Inspection and weighing requirements upon grain delivery
headings.reviewNote: Requires official inspection and weighing on delivery from terminal warehouse unless directed otherwise by owner or warehouseman.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed terminal warehouse receipt, inspection, weighing, and grading duties upon receipt and delivery with section 411.030 opt-out.

headings.title: Duty to receive grain and inspection options for non-terminal warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiving suitable grain, permitting agreed representative samples sent to licensed inspector, agreed grades, or official state inspection.

headings.title: Issuance of warehouse receipts for company-owned grain
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes warehousemen to issue warehouse receipts for company-owned grain pursuant to director regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed nonterminal warehouse receipt/grading options (representative sample, agreed grade, or official service) and company-owned grain receipts.

headings.title: Scale ticket marking for storage, sale, or other purpose
headings.reviewNote: Requires marking scale tickets upon delivery to indicate whether grain is delivered for storage, sale, or other purpose.

headings.title: Presumption of storage grain in licensed warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Deems received grain storage grain unless paid upon delivery, priced within 30 days, or entered onto settlement sheet with 180-day contract.

headings.title: Presumption of storage grain in unlicensed warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Deems grain in unlicensed facilities storage grain unless sale price is established and paid within 30 days or formal contract executed.

headings.title: Deferred pricing, payment, and minimum price agreements
headings.reviewNote: Governs written deferred pricing, deferred payment, and minimum price contracts (restricted to class I grain dealers), requiring ownership relinquishment and section 276.461 terms.

headings.title: Transactions excluded from warehouseman bond coverage
headings.reviewNote: Excludes accepted checks, signed promissory notes, and purchase contracts from warehouseman bond coverage.

headings.title: Mandatory bond coverage for deemed storage grain
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that warehouseman's bond shall cover all grain deemed storage grain under this section.

headings.title: Subsequent sale of stored grain to warehouseman
headings.reviewNote: Treats stored grain subsequently sold to warehouseman as priced at sale date, applying 30-day, 180-day, and contract rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections and 1997 effective date; edited subsection 4 title to cover deferred pricing, deferred payment, and minimum price agreements alongside storage presumptions and bond coverage rules.

headings.title: Storage of grain in special bins upon owner request
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes storing grain separately in special marked bins upon owner request and warehouseman consent.

headings.title: Special bin receipt marking requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires receipts issued for special bin grain to state special bin status and bin numbers on face.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1965 enactment note; confirmed permissive special-bin storage upon owner request and mandatory special-bin and bin-number receipt markings.

headings.title: Conditioning of special bin grain and nonliability for heating
headings.reviewNote: Permits drying and cleaning special bin grain upon receipt surrender, exempting warehouseman from heating damages absent negligence.

headings.title: Notice of deteriorating grain and public advertisement
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate owner notice or newspaper advertising and bulletin posting when special bin grain deteriorates.

headings.title: Enumeration of receipts and delivery upon receipt surrender
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to describe receipts embracing grain quantity, directing delivery upon receipt return and cancellation.

headings.title: Duty of care and segregation of deteriorating grain
headings.reviewNote: Requires continued care and segregation of deteriorating special-bin grain after notice; source note flags 'store' appears in original rolls for 'storage'.

headings.title: Delivery restricted to owner or receipt holder
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits delivering special bin grain to anyone other than lot owners or receipt holders.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and source notes; confirmed special-bin conditioning, deteriorating-grain notice, and delivery restrictions, noting original-rolls footnote flagging 'store' for 'storage' in subsection 4.

headings.title: Mandatory receipt issuance on director-approved printed forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing receipts upon depositor request, authorizing director to print and approve all warehouse receipts and certificates.

headings.title: Felony penalty for unapproved or counterfeit receipts
headings.reviewNote: Makes issuing unapproved or counterfeit warehouse receipts a class D felony.

headings.title: Surrender of unused receipts upon license termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires returning unused receipts upon license expiration or revocation, with prompt director notice to outstanding receipt holders.

headings.title: Prohibition against issuance of receipts by unlicensed persons
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unlicensed persons from issuing negotiable warehouse receipts or collateral receipts, classifying violations as class D felonies.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed director-approved receipts, counterfeit class D felony, unused receipt surrender, and unlicensed issuance felony.

headings.title: Statutory terms required on face of warehouse receipts
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory receipt terms: warehouse location, date, number, receiving mode, delivery terms, charges, weights, dockage, grade, and ownership.

headings.title: Receipt as document of title and prima facie evidence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes receipts as documents of title and prima facie evidence of depositor claims notwithstanding completion errors.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1981 effective date; confirmed ten mandatory warehouse receipt terms and status as document of title and prima facie evidence regardless of completion errors.

headings.title: Shipment of carlots to terminal warehouse at owner risk
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public warehouseman to ship carlots to terminal warehouses at owner risk, exchanging receipts upon charge payment.

headings.title: Forwarding grain to approved off-site warehouses for storage
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes forwarding nonreceipted grain to licensed Missouri, federal, or approved out-of-state warehouses at original warehouseman risk.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed owner-risk carlot shipments to terminal warehouses and off-site forwarding to cover nonreceipted storage obligations at original warehouseman's risk.

headings.title: Director order for grain delivery upon indemnity bond
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to order grain delivery for lost negotiable receipts upon proof, indemnity bond, and payment of costs.

headings.title: Warehouseman affidavit for lost or destroyed receipts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes affidavits by warehouseman and receipt holder confirming full payment or delivery when warehouseman loses receipt.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1941/1980 history note; confirmed director delivery order with indemnity bond for holder-lost receipts and affidavit procedure for warehouseman-lost receipts.

headings.title: Actual grain delivery required before receipt issuance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing receipts without actual grain delivery into store or for quantities exceeding received grain.

headings.title: Division and consolidation of warehouse receipts
headings.reviewNote: Governs dividing or consolidating receipts, requiring cancellation of old receipts and limiting consolidations to dates within 30 days.

headings.title: Receipt surrender required prior to grain delivery
headings.reviewNote: Bars delivery under negotiable receipts until returned and cancelled, and under nonnegotiable receipts without return or written order, requiring surrender before final delivery.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1965 enactment note; edited subsection 3 title to cover surrender requirements for both negotiable and nonnegotiable receipts prior to delivery.

headings.title: Duty to maintain sufficient grain inventory to meet obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehousemen to maintain stored grain inventories of sufficient quantity, quality, and grade to meet storage obligations.

headings.title: On-site inventory requirement for negotiable warehouse receipts
headings.reviewNote: Mandates maintaining grain covered by negotiable receipts at the specific licensed facility where deposited.

headings.title: Permissible inventory representations for other storage obligations
headings.reviewNote: Allows other storage obligations to be represented by on-site grain, state or federal warehouse receipts, or approved out-of-state receipts.

headings.title: Storage restricted to licensed facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires all stored grain to be maintained in licensed facilities.

headings.title: Evidence of title for forwarded grain
headings.reviewNote: Directs title to forwarded grain to be evidenced as prescribed by director rule.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1977 enactment note; confirmed sufficient inventory duty, on-site negotiable receipt inventory, permissible off-site representations, licensed-facility mandate, and forwarded-grain title rules.

headings.title: Safe maintenance of perpetual inventory and transaction records
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining current perpetual inventory, non-scale-ticket transaction register, and periodic insurance report in a place of safety at the warehouse or approved headquarters.

headings.title: Maintenance of adequate financial records
headings.reviewNote: Requires warehousemen to maintain financial records clearly reflecting current position and supporting submitted filings.

headings.title: Additional records and reports required by director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require additional records or reports to protect grain depositors and sellers.

headings.title: Three-year and six-year record retention periods
headings.reviewNote: Establishes general three-year retention period, extending retention to six years for cancelled receipts and receipt registers.

headings.title: Availability of records for auditor examination
headings.reviewNote: Mandates holding all records available for examination during business hours or upon prescribed notice.

headings.title: Class D felony for false records or concealment
headings.reviewNote: Classifies filing false records, withholding accounts, or concealing storage obligations from auditors as a class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); edited subsection 1 title to replace misleading 'safety records' with safe maintenance of perpetual inventory and transaction records.

headings.title: Consecutive scale tickets required for all grain movements
headings.reviewNote: Requires consecutively numbered scale tickets for all in/out grain movements, filing numerical copies, and stating purchase prices.

headings.title: Scale ticket as nonnegotiable document of title
headings.reviewNote: Establishes scale tickets as nonnegotiable documents of title and prima facie evidence of grain claims.

headings.title: Required contents of scale tickets
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates required scale ticket contents: customer name, date, grain type, quantity, in/out notation, and purpose/price.

headings.title: Custom weighing tickets and designation
headings.reviewNote: Defines custom weighing for third parties, requiring clear custom weight designation and rule compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1997 effective date; confirmed consecutive scale tickets, nonnegotiable document-of-title status, seven required entries, and custom weighing definition.

headings.title: Shortage compliance notice and ex parte seizure petition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes shortage notices to cease operations or purchase grain, empowering director to petition for ex parte seizure.

headings.title: Grounds for license discipline and asset seizure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes license modification/suspension or ex parte asset seizure upon evidence of insolvency, shortage, or inability to pay.

headings.title: Disciplinary orders, certified notice, and appeal bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires written disciplinary orders, establishing 30-day appeal timeline and mandatory appeal bond covering grain obligations.

headings.title: Ex parte judicial seizure order and lockdown powers
headings.reviewNote: Empowers circuit courts to issue ex parte seizure orders authorizing facility lockdown, employee exclusion, account freezes, and asset sales.

headings.title: Warehouseman response and fifteen-day hearing requirement
headings.reviewNote: Allows warehouseman to challenge seizure within ten days, requiring court hearing within fifteen days without stay.

headings.title: Surety notice, shortage audit, and depositor notifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to surety, shortage audit, and notifications to receipt holders to present claims.

headings.title: Retention of possession and nonliability for warehouse nonoperation
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to retain possession until claims are satisfied or court orders release, disclaiming liability for nonoperation.

headings.title: Petition for appointment of receiver upon insolvency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to petition circuit court for appointment of receiver to operate or liquidate insolvent warehouse.

headings.title: Recovery of seizure expenses and fifty-dollar daily fee
headings.reviewNote: Permits recovery of necessary seizure and receivership expenses, including liability insurance and a $50 per person daily fee for seizure and possession activities.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all nine subsections and 1997 effective date; edited subsection 9 title to reflect $50 daily fee for seizure/possession activities and confirmed shortage notice, ex parte seizure, appeal bond, and receivership headings.

headings.title: Thirty days notice of discontinuance, grain disposal, and bank deposit
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' notice of discontinuance, depositor grain removal, or sale and bank deposit of unclaimed proceeds.

headings.title: License invalidity upon ownership changes and successor agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes invalidating licenses upon ownership or corporate changes, requiring receipt returns, successor licenses, and audits.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed 30-day discontinuance notice, successor assumption, unclaimed grain sale/bank deposit, and license invalidity upon ownership or corporate changes.

headings.title: Agreements with Commodity Credit Corporation for joint examinations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to enter agreements with Commodity Credit Corporation to standardize examination procedures and share information.

headings.title: Reimbursement of expenses deposited in agricultural fees fund
headings.reviewNote: Provides for federal reimbursement of division expenses deposited in state treasury to credit of agricultural fees fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1965 enactment note; confirmed Commodity Credit Corporation and federal agency examination agreements and deposit of reimbursements into the agricultural fees fund.

headings.title: Nonexclusive nature of statutory remedies and civil actions
headings.reviewNote: Provides statutory remedies are cumulative and do not bar civil actions against warehouseman or surety on storage contracts.

headings.title: Bond recovery restricted to eligible depositors
headings.reviewNote: Restricts bond payments exclusively to depositors possessing a statutory right of recovery under chapter provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 effective date; confirmed nonexclusive cumulative remedies and restriction of bond payments to depositors with statutory recovery rights.

headings.title: Prominent sign required for state licensed warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Requires prominent display of sign stating warehouse is licensed under Missouri Grain Warehouse Law, Chapter 411.

headings.title: Prominent sign required for unlicensed warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Requires unlicensed public warehouses to display sign stating warehouse is NOT licensed under Missouri Grain Warehouse Law.

headings.title: Prominent sign required for federally licensed warehouses
headings.reviewNote: Requires federally licensed warehouses to display sign stating warehouse is licensed under United States Warehouse Act.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty and daily fine for failure to display sign
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failure to display required sign as a misdemeanor subject to fine up to $300 per day.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections, 1993/1994 history, and cross-reference note to section 276.582 (attorney general investigation/prosecution); confirmed licensed, unlicensed, and federal sign requirements and $300/day penalty.

headings.title: Statutory definition of warehouseman failure
headings.reviewNote: Defines failure as insolvency, license revocation, refusal to redeliver grain, failure to renew, or voluntary license surrender.

headings.title: Definition of grain or grain-related assets
headings.reviewNote: Defines assets of failed warehouseman to include owned or stored grain, transit grain, sales proceeds, margin equities, and traceable property.

headings.title: Establishment of statutory lien on grain assets
headings.reviewNote: Establishes statutory lien on grain and grain-related assets in favor of receipt holders and depositors with storage evidence.

headings.title: Attachment, priority, and automatic assignment of statutory lien
headings.reviewNote: Provides lien attaches upon storage obligation and is assigned by operation of law to department of agriculture for liquidation.

headings.title: Director enforcement of lien and allocation of liquidation proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to enforce lien and allocate proceeds for benefit of receipt holders and storage claimants.

headings.title: Assignment of lien to claimants in adversary proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, upon claimant application when the department declines an adversary proceeding, to assign the lien if it will not delay resolution, liquidation, or distribution.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1997 effective date; retained titles and updated subsection 6 note to preserve mandatory 'shall assign' duty for claimant adversary proceedings.
